description: 40+ years of building experience, all in one channel. Learn house-building, carpentry & construction, blacksmithing, safety & productivity,  how other trades & shops function, and maybe even how to be a better version of ourselves! The videos feature Scott Wadsworth covering a wide array of topics, tools, history, and lessons learned. The purpose of the channel is to showcase the knowledge that is gained through experience, and encourage respect for the craftsmen, their tools, and history.
